rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents under its Rent Control Ordinance, which the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers and enforces. The page names the ordinance and says properties with 1-4 units are exempt. It gives no increase formula.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental properties with five or more units are covered. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt. Other exemptions may be granted on request.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: The ordinance provides other permitted exemptions, which owners can request through a Rent Control Exemption Request. The page does not list them.

rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Owners meeting criteria for other permitted exemptions may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
